description:
Every crate-jmap-*-server/README.md ('How it works → Registration', 'CallerCtx' section, 'Known Limitations' section) says CallerCtx is 'discarded' via `ClosureHandler`. Affected README files:

- crate-jmap-mail-server/README.md
- crate-jmap-chat-server/README.md
- crate-jmap-contacts-server/README.md
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/README.md
- crate-jmap-sharing-server/README.md
- crate-jmap-tasks-server/README.md
- crate-jmap-filenode-server/README.md

Code in all seven uses `ClosureHandlerWithCtx` (introduced in commit 6219522 'feat: CallerCtx forwarding in all register_*_handlers via ClosureHandlerWithCtx'). The inline rustdoc on `register_*_handlers` says: 'CallerCtx IS now forwarded as _ctx'.

So inside docs.rs / cargo doc, the README and the rustdoc on the registration function literally contradict each other.

Fix: rewrite the README sections to describe `ClosureHandlerWithCtx` as the standard path, mention that `ClosureHandler` (no ctx) still exists for cases where the caller doesn't need ctx, and remove the 'CallerCtx is discarded' Known Limitation. Coordinate the wording across all 6 READMEs since the description should be identical.
title: P2: ClosureHandler vs ClosureHandlerWithCtx README staleness across 6 server crates
